description: Normal-room classes from the scripted sweep (room_sweep.py, 2026-09-26, invincible, 0 bombs)
method: turret: stand at the entrance and shoot along the aim / nearest target axis, 60 s; walker: walk the walking-distance descent to a firing position and shoot, 60 s; idle: 15 s without input, an enemy chases when it comes within 60 px or closes in by 80 px; non_chasing needs at least one starting enemy; spawn_income = (spawned HP / 5 + 0.25 per spawn) per second of the idle run
